denominator_policy: Every entry is infrastructure- or contract-invalid and is excluded from model denominators. Raw outputs remain on the ali-owned PVC.

attempts.reason: Initial model-free Isaac launches stopped before a valid exact-scene fixture because the portable environment inherited an unwritable cache, the selected Vulkan ICD path was absent, and libGLU/libXt dependencies were missing. One retry overlapped another exact-scene preflight and segfaulted during RTX plugin teardown.
attempts.resolution: Selected the live /etc/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json mount, isolated writable caches, prevented concurrent Isaac launches, and staged the missing Ubuntu 22.04 native libraries in a user-owned PVC prefix.

attempts.reason: Vulkan recognized the RTX device, but libGLU/libXt were still missing and an overlapping preflight left the MDL renderer startup invalid.
The isolated native-library repair allowed exact-scene creation, but buffered shutdown hid the downstream missing-right-camera adapter exception and no fixture or manifest was produced.
attempts.resolution: Added durable milestone and technical-failure retention before the Isaac shutdown path.

attempts.reason: The neutral reset and both false predicates passed, then the official DreamZero adapter raised KeyError: over_shoulder_right_camera because the default RoboLab registration exposed only left-shoulder and wrist image observations.
attempts.resolution: Use RoboLab's upstream WRIST_LEFT_RIGHT policy-camera preset, which adds the official mirrored right-shoulder sensor without changing objects, reset state, or predicates.

attempts.reason: A first camera repair referenced a configclass field at class scope and failed during task import before scene creation.
The right camera sensor was attached at the task scene layer but not added to RoboLab's image-observation group, so the official adapter still rejected the observation.
attempts.resolution: Replaced the task-local camera edit with the upstream WRIST_LEFT_RIGHT registration preset for both sensors and observation terms.

attempts.reason: The first isolated torchrun workers did not inherit the exact official DreamZero source root on sys.path and raised ModuleNotFoundError: socket_test_optimized_AR before checkpoint construction or GPU allocation.
attempts.resolution: Add the exact official ab790c1 source root to PYTHONPATH for every distributed rank and use a fresh run and future directory.

attempts.reason: Transformers 4.51.3 imported DeepSpeed 0.19.3 from modeling_utils; DeepSpeed then imported modeling_opt during partial Transformers initialization, producing a circular PreTrainedModel import before checkpoint construction.
attempts.resolution: Import DeepSpeed before the official server module, matching the explicit import-order compatibility fix audited in the pre-existing source while leaving official checkpoint behavior unchanged.

attempts.reason: The released loader materialized the complete checkpoint state dictionary independently on both ranks before model construction and reached the pod's 68719476736-byte host-memory cgroup; memory.events recorded oom=1 and oom_kill=1 and rank 1 exited by SIGKILL before a listener existed.
attempts.resolution: Install a load-time-only overlay gated to the exact official base_vla.py hash: meta-device construction, one safetensors shard at a time, assign=True without dtype/value conversion, garbage collection after each shard, and strict rejection of any missing, unexpected, duplicate, or remaining-meta tensor.

attempts.reason: The bounded shard loader passed independently on both ranks with 2146/2146 keys and no missing, unexpected, or meta tensors, but the exact released action-head constructor still performed redundant T5, CLIP, and VAE ensure_file/load_state_dict calls before shard assignment. This triggered a Hugging Face Xet access and loaded component payloads that were no-ops on meta tensors. The guarded process group was terminated before a listener existed or any request was made.
attempts.resolution: Add an exact-action-head-hash-gated, construction-only overlay matching the audited old patch's three-component skip. Restore all monkeypatches before strict full-checkpoint assignment; exclude every old forward, offload, and KV-cache change.
